delivered: The full-frame document workspace replaces the rotation slider. Direct crop with four handles and keyboard movement is unchanged; zoom 100-400% with panning bounded to the part of the image pushed outside the frame; straightening by drawing a line along a rule on the sheet; quarter turns; tenth-of-a-degree steps and an exact numeric angle. The dimming mask is clipped to the stage, so it no longer spills over the controls.

originalKept.howToReinstate: Set STUDENT_SCAN_EDITOR to 'classic'. Both surfaces take the same props and both keep their own tests, so the comparison is one value rather than a revert.
originalKept.why: Requested for side-by-side comparison, the same arrangement as the previous dictation pipeline kept as a benchmark.

documentEditorTests: the workspace renders and no range input exists anywhere in it
the angle moves in tenths, by quarter turns and by exact entry
a line drawn at 45 degrees rotates the sheet back by 45 and releases the mode
a tap too short to be a line is ignored rather than snapping to a wild angle
zoom is bounded and reset returns angle, crop, zoom and pan together
crop keyboard movement, the focus trap and Escape still work
